findings.explanation: The Splunk Universal Forwarder is downloaded from splunk.com, not Splunkbase, and it has no SNMP polling input; splunkbase.splunk.com/app/617 returns 404. A reader following this would install a forwarder and get no PDU data.
findings.quote: Collected via Universal Forwarder (Splunkbase 617) modular input or scripted poll
findings.suggested_fix: Name the actual SNMP collector: Splunk Connect for SNMP (containerised, sends to HEC) or the SNMP Modular Input (Splunkbase 1537) on a heavy forwarder, polling PowerNet-MIB rPDULoadStatusTable. Drop the Universal Forwarder and the 617 ID.

findings.explanation: The app field offers SC4SNMP, but SC4SNMP writes polling events as sourcetype sc4snmp:event to index netops by default, while the spl expects sourcetype snmp:apc:pdu in index=power with flat fields such as pdu_name. Neither app nor detailedImplementation explains the sourcetype or index override, or how pdu_name gets extracted. The repository guide uses sourcetype snmp:pdu / snmp:rpdu instead.
findings.quote: Splunk Connect for SNMP (SC4SNMP) or SNMP Modular Input
findings.suggested_fix: State which collector produces sourcetype snmp:apc:pdu. For SC4SNMP, document the sourcetypePollingEvents/eventIndex overrides and the props that extract pdu_name and the phase load fields; otherwise align with the guide's snmp:pdu sourcetype.

findings.explanation: There is no imbalance threshold, no units note (the PowerNet load values are tenths of amps), and no warning that on three-phase multibank 1G Rack PDUs the rPDULoadStatusTable instances are banks, not phases. A reader cannot tell what counts as unbalanced.
findings.quote: (1) Three-phase PDUs only. (2) Export top imbalanced PDUs quarterly.
findings.suggested_fix: Add an imbalance criterion (for example, max phase-to-phase difference as a percentage of the mean phase current, with a site-chosen threshold). Note the /10 scaling and the phase-versus-bank instance ordering of rPDULoadStatusTable, and say which PDU models report per-phase rather than per-bank values.

findings.explanation: These are generic REST-API and HEC troubleshooting steps. The data is SNMP polling, so the real failure modes (community/SNMPv3 credentials, UDP 161 reachability, MIB loading, timeouts) are missing. The 'joins/lookups enrich owner' text describes SPL that does not exist.
findings.quote: Enable the modular input or HEC token ... unless the vendor API rate-limits lower ... inspect splunkd.log for HTTP 401/429 from the vendor endpoint configured in inputs.conf.
findings.suggested_fix: Rewrite the steps for SNMP polling of PowerNet-MIB rPDULoadStatusLoad: SNMPv3 credentials, poll interval, MIB availability for name translation, verifying pdu_name extraction, and SNMP timeout errors in the collector logs.

findings.explanation: The listed scenarios are template filler that don't describe a real cause of an apparent phase imbalance. The SPL also has no threshold to cross.
findings.quote: Batch `max` on `snmp:apc:pdu` — Scheduled automation elevates `l1` without crossing configured threshold
findings.suggested_fix: List real causes: a single large single-phase load (such as a blade chassis) on one phase by design, PDUs where instances 1-3 are banks rather than phases, a missing phase sample that makes the imbalance calculation null or skewed, and planned load migrations during moves.

findings.explanation: The SPL references non-existent MIB objects and the collection path is wrong, so the UC cannot have been run and signed off as written.
findings.suggested_fix: Set status to draft or unverified until an SME runs the search against real PowerNet-MIB data.

findings.explanation: Splunk Connect for SNMP is not distributed through Splunkbase; this search link does not lead to the product.
findings.suggested_fix: Link the SC4SNMP documentation (https://splunk.github.io/splunk-connect-for-snmp/) and a PowerNet-MIB reference for rPDULoadStatusTable.

findings.explanation: The detection uses polled phase load values, not SNMP traps.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove snmp_trap unless a trap-based variant is added.

firewalled_field_flags.issue: rPDUPhaseStatusLoad, rPDUPhaseStatusLoad2 and rPDUPhaseStatusLoad3 are not PowerNet-MIB objects. Per-phase/bank current is the single column rPDULoadStatusLoad (tenths of amps), returned as one instance per phase or bank (https://oidref.com/1.3.6.1.4.1.318.1.1.12.2.3.1). On three-phase multibank 1G PDUs, instances 1-3 are banks rather than phases (https://www.apc.com/us/en/faqs/FA156142/), so l1/l2/l3 must come from instance-indexed values filtered by rPDULoadStatusPhaseNumber.
The title says 'Branch Circuit' load balancing, but the SPL computes whole-PDU phase (L1-L3) averages; no branch circuit or breaker is measured.

summary: Template-generated sidecar around a phase-imbalance report whose SPL reads PowerNet-MIB object names that do not exist. The collection path (Universal Forwarder as a Splunkbase SNMP input) is wrong, and the implementation text describes HEC and vendor REST APIs rather than SNMP polling.
